def steep(ingredient, liquid, duration):
    """Steep an ingredient in liquid so that its compounds can diffuse while time passes."""
    mixture = f"{ingredient} placed in {liquid}"
    for minute in range(duration):
        mixture += " · diffusion continues"
    return mixture
